# Data Processing and Security Addendum

## Addendum Identity

Addendum ID: DPA-ACME-2026

Related Agreement: MSA-ACME-2026

This addendum applies to all hosted services that process Customer Data.

## Data Use

The Provider may process Customer Data only to provide, secure, support, and improve the contracted services for the Customer.

The Provider may not sell Customer Data or use Customer Data for marketing.

The addendum does not state a data residency restriction or require United States-only hosting.

## Security Controls

The Provider must maintain encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication for administrative access, daily backups, and annual SOC 2 Type II reporting.

Security obligations cover encryption, access controls, MFA, incident notice, backups, and annual SOC 2 reporting.

## Security Incident Notice

The Provider must notify the Customer within 48 hours after confirming unauthorized access to Customer Data.

The notice must describe known affected systems, categories of data, containment status, and the next update time.

## Subprocessors

The Provider must maintain a current subprocessor list.

The Provider must give the Customer at least 10 business days' notice before adding a material subprocessor.

## Post-Termination Data Return

The Provider must make a Customer Data export available for 30 days after termination or expiration.

The Provider must delete remaining Customer Data and provide a deletion certificate within 45 days after the Customer confirms export completion.
